text: Binary per-row: 1 if at least one other user's comment in OC_comments (parsed JSON list) directly quotes wording from the OP's argument text (verbatim or near-verbatim quoted or block-quoted passage matching the argument), whether the commenter agrees, disagrees or refutes; title is used only for context. Paraphrase without quoted wording, quotes of other comments or external sources, and quoting only the title don't count. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment quotes the argument, or if it is a valid empty list; null if OC_comments or argument is missing or malformed. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and outcome-reporting text, even inside the argument or comments, and quotes of such content don't count; generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Uses current text including marked edits; list order is irrelevant.
